findings.finding: Each fresh select_window rebuilds up to500 EditionViews, turns them into edition->work map, and eagerly requests one more full EditionView. Only IDs/work pairs and last edition ID are used. The full ordered allowed map remains part of window identity.

browse_editions uses an authorized current transaction/workspace/foreign-key/collection boundary, a fixed indexed keyset CTE with exact literal filters, then LEFT JOINs every selected work's authors, orders those rows, groups metadata, and creates complete EditionView records. select_window does not consume asset/title/language/edition/volume/authors after filtering.

Candidate-only reuse changes none of this. Full37-hit result calls still execute a second fresh search. Each search redoes select_window and passes all up-to500 allowed edition IDs, plus up-to100 actual page IDs, into literal search.

count_derivation.static_inference: For the measured full100-hit synthetic windows, calls37/37/26 yield two lookaheads, hence five fresh searches/select_window calls per window (about50000). A500-identity view per call implies about25million EditionView constructions before metadata/author join fanout. This is derived control-flow work, not a profiler count or attribution of the3508s.
count_derivation.two_million: With otherwise identical100-hit windows, the complete2M traversal would roughly double those catalog calls before considering its40-segment source-attestation costs. No timing or completion prediction is made.
